title: Values Computation Sheet: Dividend Accumulations Withdrawn at a Whole Life Insurance Reduced Paid-Up Election
content:
When the owner of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy elects reduced paid-up insurance, the dividend accumulation deposit is withdrawn in one amount.

## Formal statement

The accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election are the dividend accumulation balance shown on the policy plus simple interest on that balance at the tier's dividend accumulation rate for the actual calendar days from the most recent policy anniversary to the date the election takes effect, over **365**; the interest is rounded half up to the cent and added to the balance.

## Terms used

| Term | Meaning in this computation |
|---|---|
| Balance shown | The dividend accumulation balance on the policy record |
| Most recent policy anniversary | The anniversary the policy's posted cash values are as of |
| Date the election takes effect | The paid-to date on the policy record |
| Dividend accumulation rate | The declared annual accumulation rate of the tier |

## Worked computation (hypothetical 20-Pay policy, accumulation rate 3.75%)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Balance shown | 8000.00 |
| Most recent anniversary | March 1, 2025 |
| Paid-to date (election effective) | September 1, 2025 |
| Actual days | 184 |
| Interest: 8000.00 times 0.0375 times 184, over 365 | 151.2329, rounded to 151.23 |
| Accumulations withdrawn | 8151.23 |

Where the paid-to date is the anniversary itself, the days are zero and the amount withdrawn is the balance shown.
